scope: zero-call engineering closure before any further extraction trial

fixes.problem: material-semantics-14 through 21 were treated as pre-structure during identity reconstruction
fixes.fix: register their persisted relation_candidate_set_id shape without dropping structure, candidate_slots or slot_ledger

fixes.problem: the development live runner retained raw responses only for failed or partial packets
fixes.fix: persist an append-only running record before each call and every successful raw response plus terminal record immediately after return

fixes.problem: an interrupted call had no durable attempt state
fixes.fix: unclassified exceptions and interruptions terminate as outcome_unknown; a started record left without terminal remains auditable and the same round/sample is refused before another request

fixes.problem: stage-1 stop conditions were evaluated only after all samples
fixes.fix: evaluate the frozen item gate after every completed sample and do not start the next sample after partial/failed or an in-scope metric floor decrease

fixes.problem: spec and report retained obsolete execution and item protocol descriptions
fixes.fix: record item protocol v5 plus validation v6 and point the historical design report to the current execution sources

fixes.problem: one compound gold target could only match one atomic predicted item
fixes.fix: scorer v3 selects the smallest compatible atomic group and aggregates mixed polarity, compound values, unknown fields and relation endpoints without changing gold or thresholds

fixes.problem: every slot reserved four possible output items, forcing 487 copper slots into 32 calls
fixes.fix: slot batching v2 reserves ordinary atomic slots by deterministic signal count while retaining four-item bounds for summaries and attribution-unavailable mixed turns

fixes.problem: the Claims binding gate had not been separated from prompt/schema repair claims
fixes.fix: zero-call audit freezes the signed 28.03% precision and 75% recall baseline, the five unmatched targets and overlapping coordinate failures; current repairs remain unpassed until one minimal Claims-only proof

fixes.problem: the scratch development runner remained an alternate live authorization path beside the formal structured ledger
fixes.fix: direct live mode now fails before budget reading or provider setup; the scratch runner retains plan-only and replay scoring while every future real request must use the structured CLI and ledger

known_baseline_failures: tests/test_corpus_preparation_readers.py::test_dev_materials_smoke_units_and_pages: environment has reader-pdf-11 while test expects reader-pdf-10

decision.next_gate: freeze P1 Claims and copper/relations as separate formal structured plans with exact attempt budgets and hashes; P1 begins with the minimal Claims-only proof and stops before copper if that gate fails
